errors.description: The leaf terminations are tapering points with a rounded apex, identical in construction to the point-collar render.
errors.expected: A flat squared terminal edge on each leaf per the label 'Square 6.5 cm with Button', the description and spec.forbidden
errors.correction: Finish each leaf with a straight flat edge about 10-12 mm long cut square across the leaf axis, giving two crisp corners with the edgestitch turning at each, and seat the tip button just inboard of that flat.

errors.description: Apex (447,515); left tip (247,800), right tip (645,800). Half-angles 35.1 and 34.8, total 69.9 degrees. Verified by projection: a 35 degree ray from the apex lands at x=247.5/646.5 which matches the tips, while a 40 degree ray would land at 208/686 which does not. The drawing prints 80.00 and is pixel-identical to square-in-65cm apart from the two tip circles, so its spread is the same about 83 as drawn.
errors.expected: 80 degrees printed, about 83 as drawn - the same spread as square-in-65cm
errors.actual: 70 degrees - about 10 narrow, and within 1 degree of the fashion-point-58 render at 71, so spread alone no longer separates them
errors.correction: Open each leaf front edge to 40 degrees off vertical from the centre-front vertex so the pair encloses 80 degrees; at the present 285px drop each tip belongs about 239px out from centre rather than the current 199.

errors.description: Button-to-tip distance as a fraction of point length. Blueprint: button centre (78,131.5), tip (77.5,137.5), 6px above the tip on a 42.5px leaf = 14 percent. Candidate: button (256,730), tip (247,800), about 72px on a 348px leaf = 21 percent.
errors.expected: Button about 14 percent of point length above the tip, tight to the point
errors.actual: About 21 percent - slightly further up the leaf than drawn
errors.correction: Move each tip button about 25px down its leaf axis so it sits about one button-diameter above the point, tight to the end of the leaf as the drawing places it.

errors.description: Point length over centre-front collar height: candidate 348/363 = 0.96; blueprint 42.5/49 = 0.87.
errors.correction: Shorten each leaf by roughly 35px along its axis so the tip finishes at 0.87 of the vertex-to-top-edge distance.

notes:
The named defect is fixed outright, and verified by pixel diff rather than impression.

A NEW DEFECT APPEARED IN THE SAME PASS: the spread dropped to 70 degrees where its own blueprint prints 80.00 and is otherwise pixel-identical to square-in-65cm, whose render came out at 89. Two drawings with the same printed angle are now 19 degrees apart, and at 70 this collides with fashion-point-58 at 71.

SPEC-VERSUS-DRAWING: the description says the collar is 'secured with a throat button', singular and at the throat, while the drawing plainly shows TWO buttons at the leaf tips - button-down, not throat-fastened. The drawing wins and the render followed the drawing, which is the right call, but the prose will keep fighting it.
